haiku:
Golden foam climbs soft
Sunlit taps hum, laughter rings
Bubbles dance, bright joy
Happy #NationalAmericanBeerDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Midnight whiskers gleam
Soft paws pat the cool stone floor
Night air hums with joy
Happy #NationalBlackCatDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Morning light calls us
Bold oak stands, roots deep, wind sings
Birthday cheers rise high
#HappyBirthdayTheodoreRoosevelt from @ClamBakeSanta
